sequences.prompt: Pixel art game VFX sprite sheet, a uniform 4-column by 3-row grid of 12 equal square cells with NO visible grid lines, borders or labels, on a fully TRANSPARENT background. The 12 cells are consecutive animation frames of ONE effect read left-to-right, top-to-bottom: a knight's steel shield bash impact — frame 1 a tiny white spark, frames 2-4 a sharp four-pointed white-blue flash with a crescent of steel-blue impact arc growing to full size, frames 5-8 the flash shrinks while 6-8 chunky blue-white sparks fly outward and fade, frames 9-12 a faint blue dust wisp dissipates to nothing.
